tools.name: kodiak_reference_search
tools.description: Search Kodiak reference library (design, reference images, training wins) by meaning using Nova multimodal embeddings. Query like 'What worked for green chile families?' or 'porch breakfast' — returns top-k past wins with market, audience, message, cue, zip.

q.description: Natural language query — place, audience, or message

tools.name: kodiak_reference_embed
tools.description: Embed text or text+image via Nova multimodal for ad-hoc RAG — returns 1024-dim vector preview (Titan fallback when multimodal not enabled).
